No new golden changes needed.

All original files accounted for; safety stash retained. Changes remain unstaged/uncommitted, nothing pushed. Full suite and opt-in database/runtime checks were not repeated. Local report: .notes/block-assist-visibility/rebase-review.md (linked from docs/specs/block-assist-visibility-outcome.md).
